notes.title: Time to Get your cute Kitty Sweater!
notes.content:
Hello adventurer,
 
The new journey in Crazy Dreamz: Best Of started last week. As a MagiCat, it’s time to check if you are fast enough! [u][b]From 27/03/2018 to 14:00 (Paris gmt+1) 30/03/2018[/b][/u], we hold [u][b]the Speedrun Contest[/b][/u] for all the players.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32263151/5c05270c9731be6dd44a761521dd14fcbedf3922.jpg[/img]

[b]The Reward: [/b] 

Super cute MagiCat Sweater! (Check it on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/crazydreamzgame/]Facebook page[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/CrazyDreamzGame]Twitter[/url] and  [url=https://discord.gg/uhkkqH6]Discord[/url])

[b]How to participate in this contest?[/b] 

Step 1: Go to Crazy Dreamz: Best Of

Step 2: Enter the [b][u]World 1[/u][/b] and choose [b][u]the level in the left bottom[/u][/b] ([u][b]Name: Beat the timer[/b][/u] and the location is following). The level has been exclusively added for this occasion and will be removed after the contest! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32263151/d15286fdbb41e6c1201e80f17fe7464c8f567e0a.png[/img]

Step 3: Try to pass it [b]AS FAST AS YOU CAN[/b]

Step 4: The player holding [u][b]the Best Time at 14:00 (Paris gmt+1) on 30/03/2018[/b][/u] will WIN.

There Is No Time for Hesitation. Let’s go!
